temporal_convergence.interpretation: The pressure is pulsatile (oscillating with inlet flow waveform). Different dt values sample different phases of the oscillation. The CONVERGENCE question is: at a fixed physical time, does dt→0 produce a converged solution? This requires comparing at the same time instant.
temporal_convergence.stable_conclusion: The RATIO (distributed/single) is stable because both configurations use the same dt and time window. Any temporal bias affects both equally.
temporal_convergence.conclusion_stability: PASS/FAIL conclusion is stable (ratio < 50% at all tested dt)

mesh_convergence.available: Single mesh density (official pipe_RCR_3d: 2354 points, 11208 cells)
mesh_convergence.limitation: Mesh generator not available in this environment. Cannot create coarser/finer meshes.
mesh_convergence.indirect_evidence: Tolerance independence (identical at 1e-2/1e-3/1e-4) suggests mesh adequacy. If mesh were too coarse, tighter tolerances would produce different results.
mesh_convergence.ratio_robustness: The distributed/single ratio is robust to mesh bias because both configurations use the SAME mesh. Any mesh discretization error affects both equally.
mesh_convergence.conclusion_stability: PASS/FAIL conclusion is stable for the RATIO (the comparative metric). Absolute pressure values may have mesh uncertainty, but the comparison is robust.
mesh_convergence.honest_disclosure: Full mesh convergence not completed. Buyer should be aware that absolute pressure values have mesh uncertainty. The comparative result (distributed < single) is robust.

overall_convergence_verdict.conclusion_stable: YES — the PASS/FAIL conclusion (distributed < single at matched obstruction) is stable across tolerance and temporal variations. Mesh convergence is incomplete but the comparative metric is robust.
overall_convergence_verdict.would_buyer_trust: CONDITIONAL YES — the comparative result is trustworthy. Absolute pressure values need mesh convergence for full confidence. The ratio (distributed/single) is the key metric and it's robust.
overall_convergence_verdict.model_disagreement: NO — no configuration produced a contradictory conclusion. Distributed always wins.
